fuel_consumption.source_quote: Fuel consumption not stated explicitly in gallons; item7a notes ~42% of 2005 fuel requirements hedged via costless collars and basis swaps. Gain on derivatives = $23.8M in 2004.

instrument_type_details.notes: Costless collar agreements and basis swaps on heating oil. ~42% of 2005 fuel requirements hedged. Net fair value = $0.2M (asset) at Dec 31, 2004 (restated; 2003 restated to $2.7M). RESTATEMENT: In February 2005, company restated 2003 and 2004 financials because hedges did not qualify for cash flow hedge accounting under SFAS 133. Gain on derivatives recognized in 2004 = $23.8M. Original FV at Dec 31, 2004 before restatement was $21.2M (restated to $2.7M at Dec 31, 2003 and $0.2M at Dec 31, 2004).
